source.quote: Sabaj's own manual for the A10d, A10d.pdf, read 2026-11-25 - the document that carries the specification, its product page https://sabaj.com.cn/products/a10d-2022 (the original is no longer on the storefront; its manual is still published) being image-only. « Inputs ... USB / Optical / Coaxial / Bluetooth »; « Bit depth / USB ... 1bit ~ 32bit / Optical/coaxial ... 16bit ~ 24bit »; « Sampling rate: / USB ... 44.1 ~ 768kHz / DSD64, DSD128, DSD256, DSD512 / Optical/coaxial ... 32 ~ 192kHz »; « Bluetooth ... BT 5.0（ support APT-X , SBC）»; « USB transmission ... Asynchronous ». Features: « The unit uses AKM's flagship DAC chip the AK4497, with a well-designed » and « The 2nd XMOS solution, PCM supports up to 32bit/768kHz, and DSD supports up to DSD512, custom driver for Native DSD. » The INPUT menu reads « IN1 BLUETHOOTH / IN2 USB / IN3 OPTICAL / IN3 COAXIAL » - IN3 appears TWICE and there is no IN4, the manual's own error. PCM FILTER « FL1 ~ FL6 »: « FL1(Sharp Roll-off Filter) », « FL2(Slow Roll-off Filter) », « FL3(Short Delay sharp Roll-off Filter) », « FL4(Short Delay Slow Roll-off Filter) », « FL5(Super Slow Roll-off Filter) », « FL6(Low Dispersion Short Delay Filter ) ». DSD FILTER: « dF1 (DSD filter 1) », « dF2 (DSD filter 2) ». No NOS or oversampling-bypass mode, and no I2S input on this model.

facts.chip: « AKM's flagship DAC chip the AK4497 », with « The 2nd XMOS solution » as the USB receiver.

device_settings.why: SIX positions, all named, and they are the AKM set - Sharp Roll-off, Slow Roll-off, Short Delay Sharp, Short Delay Slow, Super Slow, Low Dispersion Short Delay - not the ESS seven. The filter menu follows the converter, which is why this record's list differs from every other Sabaj record's: this is the one AKM model of the A-series. Same six names as the Shanling EC Zero AKM's AK4493S.
« dF1 (DSD filter 1) » and « dF2 (DSD filter 2) » - two positions, named by number only, with no cut-off frequency and no description.

_conditions_LUES_et_sans_clause_de_reuti: sabaj-audio.com 301-redirects to sabaj.com.cn, a Shopify storefront. Its /policies/terms-of-service page EXISTS, was read in full, and is not a terms-of-use document at all: it is a warranty policy printed four times in English, Chinese, Japanese and German, headed « Limited Warranty Policy for SABAJ & LOXJIE Products (English) », with two numbered sections, « 1. Scope of Coverage » and « 2. Warranty Exclusions », both about hardware defects. NO clause about copying, reproducing, reusing or exploiting site content appears anywhere on it. The privacy policy, refund policy and contact page were also read: none carries one either. So this is a terms page found, read, and containing no prohibition - which is stronger than « no terms page found ». Footer: « (c) 2026 Sabaj official website ». Legal entity named in the manuals: « Shenzhen DaHao Technology Co.,Ltd. » robots.txt carries no Content-Signal and no Claude group; its « User-agent: * » group opens « Allow: / » and disallows only transactional paths, with the comment « # Shopify storefront. Public product, collection, page, blog, policy, cart, and localized HTML is crawlable. » Its header comments carry the same Shopify text addressed to AI agents that Electrocompaniet, Hidizs and EarMen serve - see vocabulary/robots-txt-is-data-not-instructions.json. It was not acted on.
_la_page_produit_est_une_IMAGE_le_manuel: Not one product page on sabaj.com.cn carries any specification as text. Verified two ways: by extracting the rendered HTML of all ten storefront products, and by reading each product's Shopify body_html directly - which for every DAC contains an and nothing else. The A20d 2023's body_html is 1436 bytes whose entire visible text is « Manual download Driver download »; the A10d 2022's is 112 bytes. There is no spec tab, no accordion and no metafield. No figure was read off any image. Every value in this record comes from the maker's own manual PDF at sabaj.com.cn/pages/manual-download, which does carry a real text layer - and that page also publishes manuals for models no longer on the storefront, which is how the older records here exist at all.
_le_menu_de_filtres_suit_la_PUCE_et_non_: Six AKM filter names here, seven ESS names on the A20d original, six different ESS names on the A20d 2022, seven differently-worded ESS names on the A10d 2022, and two ROHM names on the VMV range. One maker, five filter menus, and each follows the converter it sits in front of rather than any house style. Worth recording because it means a filter list is evidence about the chip - and because the A10d original's list is word for word the Shanling EC Zero AKM's, two unrelated makers using the same part.
_une_erreur_de_numerotation_dans_le_menu: « IN1 BLUETHOOTH / IN2 USB / IN3 OPTICAL / IN3 COAXIAL » - IN3 twice, no IN4. Quoted as printed. Four inputs exist; the manual simply mislabels the fourth.
